description.value: Jasmine Mediterranean Foods is a neighborhood grocery and halal butcher shop on Main Street in Vancouver, stocking fresh halal meats alongside packaged Mediterranean and Middle Eastern specialty foods. The business also runs a separate wholesale distribution operation at a different Fraser Street address. Cyclists riding Main Street will find it a useful resupply stop for specialty pantry items, teas, and packaged goods with a Middle Eastern focus.
